title: the Ninefold Court Rising Again
author: Ulyana Ravensworth
blurb: Odile Eastwick, a thief who steals memories, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
